title: Counterexample Guided Program Repair Using Zero-Shot Learning and MaxSAT-based Fault Localization
review_status: full-text audit complete; sample, six-model design, repair rates, complexity quartiles, prompt ablations, and reference-copy/edit-size caveats checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-12-19; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Across 1,431 introductory C student programs, best all-model portfolio repairs 1,190 (83.2%) with reference implementations vs 907 (63.4%) strongest listed no-reference configuration; copying/edit-size concerns and low hardest-quartile success (17.1%) bound the result. Counterexamples vary by model/configuration.
